biggest_catch: Your friend must not already be an Ent member, must open a savings account with $5 plus a No Strings or Broncos Checking account, and within 30 days deposit $100 into the checking account AND activate the debit card.
catches: Referring Members will receive $50 and their Friend will receive $50, redeemable as electronic Visa or Amazon.com gift cards.
Friends must be legal US residents, at least 18, not already an Ent member, qualify for Ent membership, and open a savings account with the $5 minimum deposit.
Friend must open a new No Strings Checking or Broncos Checking account and within 30 days of account opening: (a) deposit $100 into the new checking account and (b) activate the debit card.
Referring Members cannot refer themselves; Friends can only receive the Friend reward once; Ent employees and officials are not eligible.
Reward redemption emails are sent within five business days of meeting offer requirements; rewards are not transferable and may not be redeemed for cash.

steps: Share your Ent referral link or referral email with a friend.
Your friend qualifies for membership and opens a savings account with the $5 minimum deposit, plus a new No Strings Checking or Broncos Checking account.
Within 30 days of account opening, your friend deposits $100 into the new checking account and activates the debit card.
You receive a $50 electronic Visa or Amazon.com gift card via redemption email within five business days (your friend also gets $50).
timing: Reward redemption emails are sent to the Referrer and Friend within five (5) business days following verification of compliance with the Terms.
